hero.subtitle: Savour the authentic flavours of Old Bengaluru with our iconic Benne Dose and timeless South Indian delicacies, cherished for over a century.

about.title: Central Tiffin Room: More Than a Meal, It's an Emotion
about.paragraph1: CTR, also known as Central Tiffin Rooms, is a legendary hotel steeped deeply in the hearts and history of Old Bengaluru. Incepted in 1920, we have been delighting patrons for over a century with our iconic Dosas, Idlis, and a variety of South Indian delicacies, which have remained timeless favorites among people of all ages. Central Tiffin Room’s rich legacy, crafted by the visionary Subramanyam brothers, Mr. Sanjeev Poojari to the current 3rd Generation baton carriers Mr. Sandesh Poojari and Ganesh S Poojari epitomizes culinary mastery and cherished tradition in all its glory.
about.paragraph2: If there’s one thing that mirrors the brand, it is the sheer love of our patrons who have been showering us with boundless love and support for the last 100+ years. Central Tiffin Room is truly "Bengaluru’s Best Benne Dose – The emotion that holds Old Bengaluru together with the essence of nostalgia in every bite." For over 104 years, this iconic eatery has cast its vintage charm, delivering the most delicious Benne Doses to the old town of Bengaluru, retaining the same cherished taste all along the way.
